messages.text: Where is my order? Order #Shop····, email (email hidden)

Hi Neelesh. Shop····, the NerdQX, was delivered on July 31, and that unit came back to our Brampton warehouse on September 24 on return ····.

Your open order is Shop····, the Harlo B30 with the free Power Kit. That one ships October 15. You can follow the batch on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Which one did you mean, the B30 date or where things stand on the NerdQX you sent back?
I meant where things stand on the NerdQX sent back as it wasn't working

Sorry, Neelesh, this one sat too long. You sent it back on September 22, it landed at our Brampton warehouse on September 24, and nobody came back to you after that. That's on us.

Your replacement is free. The NerdQX itself is discontinued, so I can't send the same unit. In the same range I have the Hammer BC04 (6 TH/s, $249), in stock in Canada and ships within 2 business days, or the Hammer Thor P2 (10 TH/s, $379), a pre-order shipping October 29.

Which would you like, or is there something else you had your eye on?
